# EvTreeItem

> One row of a Tree: indented by level, with a chevron that expands its children and an optional checkbox for selection.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:tree-item` |
| Layer | Organism (`src/organisms`) |
| Import | `import { EvTreeItem } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvTreeItem>` or `<ev-tree-item>` |
| Source | `src/organisms/tree/EvTreeItem.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the root `<div class="ev-tree-item">` |
| Used inside | `evoq-ui:tree` (EvTree) |

## Props (9)

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `level` | `number` | `1` | no | Nesting depth, 1-8. The design system only draws eight. |
| `label` | `string` | — | no | — |
| `hasChild` | `boolean` | `true` | no | Figma's `Has Child`: the node can be opened, so it gets a chevron. Defaults to true, as the component set does. |
| `expanded` | `boolean` | `false` | no | — |
| `selected` | `boolean` | `false` | no | — |
| `hasCheckbox` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Figma's `Has Checkbox`: puts a selection box before the label. |
| `checked` | `boolean` | `false` | no | — |
| `indeterminate` | `boolean` | `false` | no | Renders the checkbox's dash, for a partly-selected subtree. |
| `checkboxLabel` | `string` | `'Pilih'` | no | Accessible name for the checkbox, which has no visible label of its own. |

**Two-way binding:** `v-model:expanded`, `v-model:checked`

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Tree**, frame `4527:86644` (Tree). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Use for hierarchical data the user navigates by expanding and collapsing — file explorers, nested categories, org charts, or a settings navigator.

### When not to use

- Don't use for flat, non-hierarchical lists — use a List or Table. Don't nest so deeply that rows become unreadable; cap the depth or paginate.

### Do

- Show a clear expand/collapse affordance on parent rows. Indent consistently per level and keep the selected row highlighted. Use checkboxes only when multi-select is needed.

### Don't

- Don't mix selection and expansion into one ambiguous click target. Don't hide whether a row has children — always show the chevron when it does.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvTreeItem`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the root `<div class="ev-tree-item">`.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:tree-item` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
